thread:
Maya Singh: Uploaded a tightened draft for the Optimize launch blog: https://drive.redwood/optimize-final-draft. Need quick passes: benchmark phrasing, hero alt text, webinar CTA, and inbound routing. Goal: publish Thu 10am PT. Approvals by Wed EOD?

Priya Rao: I'll review headline + CTA. Proposed CTA: 'Register for the Optimize launch webinar — Apr 7, 10am PT'.

Samir Patel: benchmark note: please use 'up to 35% lower per-token cost on steady-state chat traces' and link the methods doc (attached). include quantization config line.

Elena Gomez: design needs hero alt text and final headline for images. Maya — alt text idea: 'Optimize dashboard comparing cost per token and throughput'.

Avery Chen: Routing: set HubSpot form id 'opt_optimize_2026', UTMs utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_2026. Hidden field 'source=blog_cta' for SDR routing. I'll configure.

LegalBot: approved with qualifier: 'based on internal benchmarks using customer-like traces; results may vary.' Need perf logs link.

Maya Singh: added perf logs and quant config. Final editorial: headline locked to A/B test. If no objections by Wed 5pm, I'll mark approved.

Priya Rao: approved.

Samir Patel: approved.

Avery Chen: form + UTMs created. approved.

Elena Gomez: assets uploaded and alt text set. approved.

LegalBot: approved (see qualifier).

Maya Singh: thanks — marking thread as final signoff and scheduling pre-publish smoke test Wed 5pm PT.
